title: Grit & Glory
author: Julian Grant
description:
A dark, shithole in Alphabet City - "Grit & Glory" was famous considering it was unknown outside of the Lower East Side.

If you wanted to make fast cash (and had a death wish), all you had to do was beat three cage fighters in a bare-knuckled brawl.

You can kick, strike, elbow, and headbutt each other ONLY.
